verdict.rationale: The homepage claims you can "Approve the big calls from your phone," and the docs describe approval of a task contract as the only gate before an agent acts. Agents poll for approved tasks on a cadence and work them as they arrive, so they keep running while a person approves. The phone part rests on a single marketing tagline, with no documented mobile app, mobile-optimized approval flow, or notifications. Missing for 10: documented mobile approval UX or app, push notifications for pending decisions, independent or hands-on corroboration of approving from a phone.
